info.title: AI-ToDu TB1 Fake REST API
info.description: Academic prototype. Node HTTP adapter persists a serialized JSON file; Service Worker adapter uses IndexedDB. No actual payments, fiscal documents, invitation delivery or production security. API fields/messages are English. Planned endpoints are intentionally absent.

servers.description: Local demo only; bundled workspace server
Browser Service Worker interception after reviewed deployment; not a public server API for curl.

post.summary: Register unique SKU with zero balance
Receive, issue or record stock loss
Assign confirmed unassigned sales and resources
Create driver; name and license required
Create vehicle; name and plate required
Create complete sale and issue stock once
Process bounded return; no actual refund
Cancel once, only without dispatch or return; restores stock

patch.summary: Advance one state; DELIVERED requires recipient
Change conservation without changing stock, name, price or cost

get.summary: List confirmed sales without dispatch or return

code.description: Stable domain error code; UI localizes it.
